findings.quote: «υπάρχει συλλογή από $k$ ζευγάρια που περιέχει ακριβώς τα παπούτσια $k$ ενηλίκων αν και μόνο αν υπάρχει κύκλος μήκους $k$»
findings.explanation: The per-k equivalence is false. Such a collection corresponds to a union of permutation cycles whose total length is k, not necessarily to one cycle of length k; for example, two 2-cycles form a valid collection for k=4 without a 4-cycle. The eventual criterion and answer remain correct because any union of total size below 5 necessarily contains a cycle of length below 5, and any such cycle itself violates the condition.
findings.suggested_action: Replace the false per-k equivalence with the invariant-subset/union-of-cycles statement, then explicitly derive that avoiding every forbidden k<5 is equivalent to requiring every cycle to have length at least 5.
